properties.sql: SELECT 'book' AS violation, company_id AS detail FROM input WHERE company_id IS DISTINCT FROM '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' UNION ALL SELECT 'branch' AS violation, CAST(c.branch_num AS VARCHAR) AS detail FROM (SELECT unnest('${ENV:BRANCH_NUMS}'::BIGINT[]) AS branch_num) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT unnest(CAST(json_extract(branch_nums, '$[*]') AS BIGINT[])) AS branch_num FROM input) w USING (branch_num) WHERE w.branch_num IS NULL

properties.sql: SELECT 'BRANCH_NUMS' AS violation, '${ENV:BRANCH_NUMS}' AS detail, 'JSON integer array, e.g. [1001,1002]' AS rule WHERE NOT regexp_full_match('${ENV:BRANCH_NUMS}', '\[[0-9]+([, ]+[0-9]+)*\]') UNION ALL SELECT 'SYSTEM_BOOK', '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}', 'digits only' WHERE NOT regexp_full_match('${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}', '[0-9]{1,32}') UNION ALL SELECT 'BIZDAY', '${BIZDAY}', 'YYYY-MM-DD' WHERE NOT regexp_full_match('${BIZDAY}', '[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}')

properties.message: EXPECTED_VALUE_MISSING_OR_MALFORMED: 期望值缺席或形状非法（{rows} 条违规，明细见上）⇒ 拒绝采集与写湖。处置：检查该管线调度/触发面的 env 注入

data.label: 空集 ⇒ 具名状态（回填日源端无结转记录）

properties.message: SOURCE_NOT_PUBLISHED: bizday=${BIZDAY} 源端零行——该营业日没有匹配的结转记录。本管线是**回填通道**：必须经 POST /api/run 显式传 params={BIZDAY:"YYYY-MM-DD"} 驱动。参数形状正确仍为零 ⇒ 源端这一天确实没结转：登记进正典 §1.7 台账后跳过，别反复重试。

properties.sql:
SELECT
  'iv-' || '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' || '-inventory_snapshot-' || replace(replace('${datetime}','-',''),'_','T') || 'Z' AS batch_id,
  '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' AS system_book,
  CAST('${BIZDAY}' AS DATE) AS bizday,
  CAST(o.branch_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
  CAST(o.branch_code AS VARCHAR) AS branch_code,
  CAST(o.branch_name AS VARCHAR) AS branch_name,
  CAST(o.storehouse_num AS BIGINT) AS storehouse_num,
  CAST(o.storehouse_code AS VARCHAR) AS storehouse_code,
  CAST(o.storehouse_name AS VARCHAR) AS storehouse_name,
  CAST(o.item_num AS BIGINT) AS item_num,
  CAST(o.item_code AS VARCHAR) AS item_code,
  CAST(o.item_barcode AS VARCHAR) AS item_barcode,
  CAST(o.item_name AS VARCHAR) AS item_name,
  CAST(o.item_spec AS VARCHAR) AS item_spec,
  CAST(o.item_unit AS VARCHAR) AS item_unit,
  CAST(o.inventory_quantity AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS inventory_quantity,
  CAST(o.inventory_assist_quantity AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS inventory_assist_quantity,
  CAST(o.inventory_use_quantity AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS inventory_use_quantity,
  CAST(o.inventory_money AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS inventory_money,
  CAST(o.carry_cost_price AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS carry_cost_price,
  CAST(o.sale_price AS DECIMAL(18,8)) AS sale_price,
  CAST(o.difference_quantity AS DECIMAL(14,6)) AS difference_quantity,
  CAST(o.difference_money AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS difference_money
FROM input o
